improvements_suggested: Implement incremental receipt caching and evidence memoization for task binding and retrospective criteria validation when upstream dependencies remain unchanged.
Instrument synthesis tasks with granular sub-phase execution timers (setup, schema verification, task contract binding, artifact serialization) to pinpoint intra-task latency.
Persist explicit synchronous execution timestamps (start, completion, duration) directly into experiment receipts to eliminate dependence on disk-mtime fallback reconstruction.
Maintain strict DualGPURunner dispatch boundaries restricted to concurrent multi-model pipelines, avoiding unnecessary invocation overhead for single-model or synthesis workloads.
Sample continuous in-flight accelerator utilization and memory telemetry during compute-bound execution intervals rather than relying solely on post-run point-in-time GPU monitor polling.
